info.title: WebFormsForCore AspNetCompiler
info.description:
A tool similar to aspnet_compiler.exe tool for WebFormsForCore, to precompile legacy .NET WebForms apps and 
            WebFormsForCore apps.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Utility to precompile an ASP.NET application

options.name: -m
options.description:
The full IIS metabase path of the application. This switch cannot
be combined with the -v or -p switches.

options.name: -v
options.description:
The virtual path of the application to be compiled (e.g.
"/MyApp"). If -p is specified, the physical path is used to
locate the application. Otherwise, the IIS metabase is used, and
the application is assumed to be in the default site (under
"/LM/W3SVC/1/Root"). This switch cannot be combined with the -m
switch.

options.name: -p
options.description:
The physical path of the application to be compiled. If -p is
missing, the IIS metabase is used to locate the app. This switch
must be combined with -v.

options.name: -u
options.description: If specified, the precompiled application is updatable.

options.name: -f
options.description:
Overwrites the target directory if it already exists. Existing
contents are lost.

options.name: -d
options.description:
If specified, the debug information is emitted during
compilation.

options.name: -t
options.description:
If specified, designates the target framework for the
compilation. If not specified the target framework is determined
from the web.config. This can also be a comma separated list of
target frameworks. If you specify a list, you must also specify
the bin folders of those TFM's using the -b parameter with the
list of bin folders.

options.name: -c
options.description: If specified, the precompiled application is fully rebuilt. Any

options.description: The virtual path of a directory that should be excluded from

options.name: -b
options.description: If specified, designates the binary folder of the project. This

options.description: The physical path to the strong name key file.
